messages:
maria: Customer (AcmePay) opened a P1 — function calls failing with 400 when model returns tool instructions. They say it used to work with OpenAI-compatible integration.

alex_k: Can you paste the customer request + the model response and our validation error?

maria: Request (from customer):
```json
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  \"model\": \"gpt-4o\",
  \"messages\": [{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"price for ABC123\"}]
}
```
Model response body we received from their side:
```json
{
  \"tool_call\": {
    \"name\": \"getPrice\",
    \"arguments\": \"{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"ABC123\\\",\\\"currency\\\":\\\"USD\\\"}\"
  }
}
```
Validation error from our gateway: `Invalid enum value \"USD\" for field \"currency\" (expected: [usd, eur, gbp])`

jamie: OK — two separate incompat issues here: 1) field names/keys: they used `tool_call` + `name` which is an older/vendor variant vs our canonical `function_call` mapping, and 2) arguments were stringified JSON (model returned args as a string) and the enum casing mismatch (USD vs usd).

sarah: Customer is on Dedicated with a monthly commit — this is blocking production traffic. They said it started after migrating to a new OpenAI-mirrored model that emits `tool_call` with string args.

alex_k: Quick repro we ran locally reproduces it. When model emits stringified args we hit our schema validator which expects an object for `arguments` and lowercase enums; we throw 400.

maria: Customer pasted a snippet of the model's choice metadata showing `tool_call` key instead of `function_call`. Screenshot attached in thread (they can't share logs).

jamie: Short-term workaround we can ask customer to set a post-processing step to parse `arguments` JSON string -> object and lowercase currency enum. But they want us to handle compatibility server-side.

sarah: Can eng-runtime add a compatibility normalize path (configurable per-customer) that: parse stringified arguments if detected, map known enum variants to canonical lowercase, and accept `tool_call` alias? We need a quick toggle we can enable for AcmePay.

alex_k: I'll put together a minimal compatibility filter: pseudocode:
```js
if (resp.tool_call) {
  fc = { name: resp.tool_call.name, arguments: tryParseJson(resp.tool_call.arguments) }
  // normalize enums
  if (fc.arguments && fc.arguments.currency) fc.arguments.currency = fc.arguments.currency.toLowerCase()
}
```
Will push behind a feature flag on the gateway and enable for AcmePay.

maria: Customer accepted temporary workaround if we can flip the flag today. They also asked for a longer-term spec note to accept both `tool_call` and `function_call` across our OpenAI-compatible inputs.

jamie: Please file an RFC in eng-runtime with test cases (stringified args, enum variants, alias keys) so we can avoid regressions. Tag me for review.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/oa-tool-compat -> staging (manual approval required) :rocket:

sarah: Thanks all — marking as escalated to oncall; I'll keep customer updated with ETA ~3h for flag rollout to staging then 6-8h for production after smoke.

maria: I'll send the customer the temporary API shim example and confirm once flag is live. :thumbsup:
